limitations: Mouse images are prepared cross-species observations, not human stage kinetics; follicle physical scale/stage/preparation details absent; mammary full width331µm per catalogue.
Growth/cycle/oocyte clocks distinct; synthetic hormone traces are prescribed qualitative states, not feedback equations, reserve forecast or clinical ovulation prediction.
Milk inventory is a single accessible compartment with constant synthetic inputs and linear effective removal; no hormone kinetics/infant transfer model.
Primordial reserve exact per-ovary slide counts discarded; no replacement individual human reserve count or deterministic age model.
Primary abstracts retrieved via EuropePMC after blocked direct pages; no claimed full-methods access to those papers.
No acceptance, real browser validation or publication status claimed; futureChapter20 navigation left plain text until its canonical file exists.
Half-open prescribed cycle domain0≤elapsed<28;280samples through27.9. The28tick denotes an unsampled next-onset boundary, not a state of the old oocyte or a predicted new lineage.
Inventory implementation uses stable small-z source gain; finite parameters with an unrepresentable total input/output are rejected. Last-bit roundoff is bounded to the analytical content interval.
